credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Cocos nucifera, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coconut . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Cocos nucifera. REARING/displaying: a fibrous, husk-brown coconut rides a curling wave, its pointed end raised toward the foe like a prow; from its stalk end a young palm sprout fans out three arching, pleated fronds (the lead frond over the foe, one straight up, the rear one back over the crest). The wave curls up behind the nut and over toward the foe; the sea runs in front of the nut. Gesture: it bobs on the wave and the fronds unfurl (it dips with its fronds furled, rises on the swell as they open, flares and settles); the wave and the sea stay fixed. A palm-green dark slot (fronds, sea, husk fibre and shade) under a husk-brown mid; the wave is the dark slot under white foam. The nut is shown from the side, its germination pores turned away. Sport: 'Malayan Dwarf', yellow form (Malayan Yellow Dwarf).
